description: List the organization's teams (read — viewer role). Archived teams are hidden unless include_inactive is set; they are kept, never deleted, so history still resolves.

function_id.description: Filter by business function — obtain from scf_list_functions

mine.description: Only teams the caller is a member of (default false); each team then also carries membership_role. 'The caller' is the API key's identity; on a self-hosted instance that is a service account on no team, so this returns nothing — use team_id instead.

name: scf_list_teams
